issue.description:
ADR-004 scoped the dependency refresh to land 'with the conformance, concurrency, and section 3.5.10 benchmark lanes rerun and the recorded benchmark budget rechecked'. The ADR's 2026-08-22 addendum records the resolved versions (rusqlite 0.31->0.40 with a much newer bundled SQLite, clap 4.6.6) and points at the store/concurrency lanes, but nothing in the supplied record shows the benchmark lanes rerun or the budget rechecked. Run the benchmark lanes against the refreshed lockfile, compare to the recorded budget, and append the measured results and the budget verdict to ADR-004.

issue.description:
Field evidence gathered 2026-10-23 on codinghome: a sweep of all 92 bead-rs workspaces under /home/coding, git object accounting in the largest repos, and every bead invocation in agent transcripts under ~/.claude/projects (32,149 calls) and ~/.codex/sessions (80,311 calls). Counts are regex-based and approximate.

Problem: output volume is the largest agent cost. Commands containing `bead` returned ~974M characters (~244M tokens). Agents trimmed show output with `head` 7,475 times and `sed` 5,770 times; 683 show calls returned more than 20k characters. Notes are 15-33% of all issue JSON bytes in NEEDLE, ARMOR, pdftract and FABRIC. A single bead's notes reach 72,840 characters (NEEDLE) and 64,291 (FABRIC), mostly accumulated re-verification write-ups. `query` has projection, but show and list do not.

Scope:
- `--fields a,b,c` on show and list, for text, JSON and --jsonl output. An unknown field exits 2 and names the valid fields from the field guide.
- `--notes none|tail:N|all` on show and list, mirroring `--comments`.
- Default text `show` prints the last 2,000 characters of notes, preceded by a line stating how many earlier characters were omitted and naming `--notes all`.
- Default JSON output is unchanged (NEEDLE contract).
- Help and the field guide recommend comments (R010) over growing notes for appended history.

Acceptance:
- `show ID --json --fields status,assignee,claim_epoch` returns exactly those members; list applies the same projection per record.
- `--notes tail:N` returns the last N characters, `none` omits the field, and `all` matches today.
- Default text show of a 70k-character note prints at most 2,000 characters of it plus the omission line.
- Default JSON for show and list is byte-identical to before.
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test pass.

issue.description:
AGENTS.md states that NEEDLE compatibility is defined by research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md and that compatibility must never be claimed without passing the corresponding conformance suite, but coverage today is piecemeal: the claim-epoch consumer canary (BR-T27) and variant-dispatch path tests, neither of which exercises the full contract surface. Build a suite that walks the complete contract the spec defines, wire it as a standing CI lane in bead-rs-ci, and gate NEEDLE-compatibility claims in release documentation on its result.
